posts.title: Different Representations
posts.description: In middle school, I got stuck on algebra. Specifically, expressions like (x + y) 2 . I was wrong, but at the time, I naively thought it became x 2 + y 2 . To solve this, we were taught FOIL, an algorithm, for expanding (x + y) 2 . It was simple enough.
